messages.text: I want a chat app for my study group

I mapped a full plan for a private, real-time study group chat with a calm focused design, group messaging, file sharing, session scheduling, and a free-tier serverless backend. Please check my assumptions: mobile-first, Supabase-style hosting, scheduling and file sharing, and no advertising. The biggest open question is whether this is just for your own group or a product other study groups could sign up for.
